# OpenLetter

> Create open letters. Collect verified signatures. Self-hostable.

OpenLetter is an open-source platform for creating, publishing, and collecting verified signatures on open letters. It is designed for campaigns, petitions, and collective statements.

## Features

- Create and publish open letters with markdown content
- Collect verified email signatures from supporters
- Customisable signature fields (name, email, organisation, role, location, comments)
- Email verification for signatures via magic link
- Public letter pages with signature counts and signatory lists
- Dashboard for managing letters, viewing signatures, and exporting data
- Self-hostable with SQLite database and Docker support

## Links

- Website: https://open-letter.uk
- Terms of Service: https://open-letter.uk/terms

## Technical

- Built with Hono (TypeScript), SQLite, server-rendered HTML
- No JavaScript frameworks, no build step
- Email via Resend or SMTP
- Deployable to Fly.io, Docker, or any Node.js host
